The '''D-4s projection platform''' from [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] was a variant of the [[D-4 mobile defense platform]]. Incom used the power systems on the base D-4 to power a holographic projector. The projector was primarily designed to create facades for buildings under construction, but some criminals realized that the D-4s could be used to disguise illicit activities and hidden bases.<ref name="Keeping the Peace">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref>
